archetypes.name: stream-contract
archetypes.rationale: This plan moves render calls with complex stdout/stderr/FD redirections into a driver whose stdout IS the KV result-env stream — any mis-redirect or guard placement gap silently corrupts routing state in ways the static panel does not specifically audit.
archetypes.prompt_body: For each `render-final-summary.sh` invocation moved into `design-route.sh`, verify the plan specifies `>/dev/null` only (not `2>&1`) so driver stdout stays a clean KV stream, and that the FD 4 quiet-mode branch (`2>&4` when `LARCH_QUIET_PID=$$`) is fully specified including the exact condition and fallback. Check whether the `set +e` / `|| true` guards are placed so a render non-zero cannot skip the `emit_route_result` / `ROUTE=` KV emission — confirm the plan's guard ordering around the render call is unambiguous. Verify exit code semantics across all cancel and resume branches: `exit 0` for every cancel route regardless of render outcome, `exit 1` reserved for resume refresh failure before any `ROUTE=` KV is written, and `exit 2` for config-contract errors only. Confirm the plan never conflates `SESSION_ID_ARG` (cancel render identity) with pause-loaded `SESSION_ID` (resume KV identity) in any shared code path. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: pin-migration
archetypes.rationale: The plan migrates a large set of numbered grep pins (FINDING-family, Check 20/21/24/26, step0b assertions) from SKILL.md to driver scripts; any pin dropped without a stated replacement silently removes regression coverage, and any 'keep unchanged' item misidentified as stable would leave a stale pin pointing at deleted code.
archetypes.prompt_body: For every FINDING-family pin, Check number, and step0b assertion cited in the plan's harness section, verify that the plan names both the specific literal being removed from SKILL.md and its exact replacement location in the driver script, with no silent drops or vague 'equivalent' references. Check that each item listed as 'keep unchanged' (FINDING_2 capture/result-env pins, FINDING_3 exit-2 prose, FINDING_9 generic abort prose, FINDING_5 cancel-pause-load) is scoped correctly — that the listed literals are actually claimed to remain in SKILL.md post-change and are not also scheduled for relocation elsewhere in the same plan. Identify any pin numbers mentioned in the plan that lack a stated replacement literal anchor or an explicit file path for the new location. Verify that the new post-fence prose gate (`[ -s "${FINAL_SUMMARY_PATH:-$DESIGN_TMPDIR/final-summary.md}" ]`) is specifically called out as a new pin target in the harness rather than described only in prose with no corresponding assertion. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
